instruction: This is the current character canon. It overrides conflicting legacy character facts in old saves, logs, local mirrors, compact canon files and retired patch artifacts. KNOWLEDGE_LOCK facts are writer/GM canon and must not automatically become in-world character knowledge. UNKNOWN/OPEN fields must remain unknown until explicitly retconned.

cao_minh.name: Cao Minh
cao_minh.source: Owner canon — Cao Minh (nhân vật chính hiện hành, owner ruling 2026-11-09)
cao_minh.runtime: Cao Minh, tôn hiệu Vạn Giới Ma Tổ, Đạo Tổ của Vạn Ma Đạo Môn; cảnh giới Chí Tôn Đại Viên Mãn. Người Trái Đất trọng sinh; rơi vào Backrooms qua khe nứt khi Lôi Thiên Vực sụp đổ (Lục Trầm hy sinh mở đường). Anh ta tới Backrooms một mình qua sự kiện rơi đó; Iris và Syvial cùng rơi trong sự kiện no-clip của prologue và đang thất lạc. Ngoài nguy hiểm hắn ung dung, ngạo nghễ, hay trêu người; gặp nguy hiểm thật sự thì quyết đoán và ưu tiên bảo vệ người vô tội/đồng đội.
cao_minh.abilities: Kiếm pháp đã khóa tên: Thiên Kiếm Thất Thức. Ngoài tên này, chi tiết từng thức chưa được khóa trong canon hiện có tại repo (UNKNOWN/OPEN — không tự điền). Sức mạnh nền tảng theo cảnh giới Chí Tôn Đại Viên Mãn; không tự suy diễn thêm cơ chế chưa có căn cứ.
cao_minh.equipment: Song kiếm Thái Cổ Song Sát: hai thanh — thanh mặt quỷ và thanh lõi đỏ; cả hai thanh cùng lơ lửng sau lưng hắn. Giáp: Hắc Long Chiến Khải. Không dùng súng, powered armor hay nhẫn lưu trữ — toàn bộ kit của nhân vật chính tiền nhiệm đã bị thay thế hoàn toàn.

iris.name: Iris / ARGUS
iris.runtime: Iris is her current legal/official name; no surname is locked. ARGUS is her SRU combat callsign. She is Scout / Target Eliminator in Cao Minh's SRU team and a real ranged combatant/Gunslinger, not a remote intelligence station. She is half-human/half-demon, daughter of Belial and a human mother who is deceased; the mother's identity, occupation, origin and cause of death remain UNKNOWN. Iris's exact birth year/origin era and exact combat tier remain UNKNOWN and must not be inferred as UR+ from Cao Minh or Syvial. Cao Minh was the first SRU member to discover her; SRU later standardized Project 07. Personality: calm, decisive, sharp, brave and caring; emotionally more transparent/tsundere around Cao Minh without becoming childish or violent.
iris.abilities: Belial Core supplies infinite demon power for her established equipment and abilities but is not a second intelligence. Thousandfold Cognition accelerates information reception/analysis up to 1:1000 and does not accelerate her body or weapon mechanisms 1000x. ARGUS Terrain Read replaces the retired EYE-infinity drone concept: it uses Iris's direct observation plus sensors in her current area to analyze terrain, routes, lines of sight, cover, ambush points and abnormal traces. It does not grant omniscience, wall vision, remote camera generation or automatic supernatural true-form detection.
iris.equipment: Current armor: SRU Recon Frame R03, a mobile black/gunmetal full-body mechanical frame with orange-red light accents, optimized for scout/ranged combat. Signature weapons: Ivory & Ebony, two large mechanical pistols synchronized with Belial Core. Their bullets are formed from Iris's demon power; she does not rely on ordinary physical magazines as the primary ammunition source. Infinite energy does not mean infinite fire rate, durability, per-shot damage, accuracy or guaranteed target identification. Field MedNet is battlefield medicine, not magical healing. Field Galley is practical field cooking/logistics, not matter creation.
iris.relationships: Iris has romantic feelings for Cao Minh; Cao Minh knows, but current canon does not establish reciprocation. Iris uses the Vietnamese anh-em address system with Cao Minh. Iris and Syvial are friends and trusted teammates with romantic rivalry around Cao Minh, not enemies; exact Iris-to-Syvial address remains UNKNOWN.

syvial.name: Syvial
syvial.runtime: Syvial is half-human/half-demon, daughter of Lucifer and a human mother whose identity remains UNKNOWN. She comes from the year 2299, which is an origin era rather than a birth year; true age remains unknown. She is UR+ and in the same overall power tier as Cao Minh. Current organization: SRU in the anti-anomalous police force; she is deputy leader of Cao Minh's team. Outside combat she is natural, social, teasing, food-loving and capable of ordinary conversation; in danger she becomes focused and precise. She is intensely yandere toward Cao Minh but remains lucid, intelligent and socially capable. She wants Cao Minh to choose her voluntarily; jealousy does not authorize random murder, mission sabotage, mind control, memory erasure or imprisonment.
syvial.abilities: Lucifer Core supplies infinite demon power, enhances physical ability/reflex/perception/regeneration, powers Lucifer Armor and synchronizes GodKiller; it is not a second intelligence. Devil Trigger does not remove control and has no invented intrinsic duration/cooldown absent from canon. GodKiller Override / Twenty-Four Severance performs exactly 24 cuts while external time is completely stopped.
syvial.equipment: GodKiller is a massive purely mechanical greatsword, not a gun or gunblade. It is linked to Syvial and may be recalled unless a sufficiently strong mechanism directly blocks that link. Lucifer Armor is a mobile full-body high-tech/mecha armor in black/gunmetal/silver with magenta light accents. Its pointed headgear modules are mechanical sensors, not biological horns. The armor is very durable and rapidly self-repairing but is not canonically absolutely indestructible.

lucia.name: Hứa Thuý Mai / Lucia Lục
lucia.runtime: Legal/real name: Hứa Thuý Mai. Lucia Lục is a military nickname/callsign, not her legal name. She is a 19-year-old human Vietnamese woman of Hoa Kiều background and a great-great-granddaughter of the Hứa family. She has one year of military service/training through a Vietnam plus United States program and achieved an excellent entrance result. She is a capable young human tactical riflewoman, not a supernatural UR+ combatant. Lucia is a story-owned fixed encounter at Level 0, not a quest/random spawn and must not be auto-created by the model. She was not part of the initial SRU group that entered the Async investigation; the initial separated group is Cao Minh, Iris and Syvial. Her initial Level 0 objective is to find a route toward Level 1.
lucia.gameplay: Locked gameplay baseline: HP 100, STR 7, DF 7, AGI 8, CRIT 7; regenerate +2 HP after every 3 separately completed turns, persisted across save/load. Current main weapon is a personalized M4A1 with physical ammunition: 60 rounds in main magazines plus 90 reserve, total 150 at baseline. She also carries a combat dagger and military navigation watch. A black handgun is visible in the thigh holster reference, but exact model/ammunition/gameplay behavior remain OPEN. Current inventory capacity baseline: 8 item types, maximum 100 units per type; equipment is managed separately.
lucia.visual: R03 visual lock: young adult face, long black hair in a high ponytail, warm brown eyes, modern camouflage/tactical kit, no helmet, personalized M4A1 with adjustable stock/rail/optic/foregrip/suppressor/light/laser as visual components. Exact height/body measurements remain OPEN. Relationship and address with Cao Minh remain OPEN.
